runtime_support: The unchanged binary asserts COUNT <= 65536 and initializes its table, hash and IR before its window loop. COUNT=16384 gives four windows per startup. Unlimited persistent operation is not supported by this binary and is not claimed.
measured_scope: Actual four-process, eight-thread group wall time, with startup amortized over four windows per worker. Every complete row must equal the frozen 16384-row reference in all modes and workers. Individual program-only durations are reported separately; they are not an observed aligned steady state.

Report the observed eight-thread amortized forecast and an explicitly ideal linear 64-thread projection (hours divided by eight). This does not measure 64-thread scalability or authorize a search. The user criterion of approximately 24 hours at 64 threads supersedes our earlier eight-thread 24-hour proposal restriction; that historical proposal remains unchanged.
